issues.on_page: Other 12,477,185 (Inheritance Fund column 2,242,946 = Inheritance 2,242,946 on Statement of Activities p2; Health Reserve 4,119,298; General 5,584,319; Road 180,031; Other Governmental 350,591)
issues.issue: A quarter of governmental receipts sits in 'other'. The Inheritance Fund column of this same line is identifiable as inheritance tax (2,242,946, p2), so that part could be separated or at least named. The rest is undescribed. A review flag is already set.
Mixed line: General Fund Miscellaneous department 9,898,931 (which includes Debt servicing 429,047, p6) plus ARPA 2,168,324. Calling it general government is defensible; a review flag is already set.
Principal and interest not separated, and the whole amount is recorded as principal. A review flag is already set.
Probably highway allocation; the page does not say so. A review flag is already set.
The amount equals Sale of surplus property 180,031 on the Statement of Activities (p2), so 'sale of assets' looks more accurate than other/miscellaneous. The match is by amount only.

Large 'other' line. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows the same 4,119,298 as Public health operating grants and contributions, so it is probably health-plan contributions (charges, reimbursements or contributions) rather than miscellaneous.
Spending from a health reserve (self-insurance) fund is more likely employee benefits than wages. A review flag is already set.

issues.on_page: Property tax 3,301,155 (Totals column; includes Visitors Promotion 893,932 and Visitors Promotion Improvements 893,932)
issues.issue: The label is as printed, but about 1.79M of this comes from the visitors promotion funds and is presumably lodging tax (Lodging 1,791,364 on p2). Recording it as property tax overstates property tax in the detail.

Broad 'Local' group in other/miscellaneous with no breakdown printed (a review flag is set). Same applies to detail[106] (Nonmajor Local 350,591, which includes Keno Lottery 69,535 and 911 surcharges 204,986 per p14).

'Operating expenses' is a catch-all object line inside a department breakdown, not a department total with no object detail. 'not itemized' is a judgment call that applies to every Operating expenses line in detail.
